title: Cover retained bridge read intent after a selected-page participant retirement
outcome: A bridge-level behavioral regression protects the original read intent/key across a selected-page participant-retirement refusal and explicit membership restoration.
acceptance: A bridge-level read that observes participant retirement after selecting its page returns the unknown refusal while preserving its existing intent and read key; it does not silently issue a replacement page.

After explicit membership restoration, resolving the same read returns the identical frozen page and receipt. The regression covers the bridge retention branch and, where a deterministic existing seam permits, the receipt-issuance retirement branch.
